_comment: Fallback output_contract, used only when case.json does not declare one. result.json.output_contract_source then reads 'default', so a reviewer can tell a real contract from this one. Keys are the field names result.json must carry; values describe what the field should contain.
methods_section: markdown text of the Methods and Experiments section, ready for the author to edit
parameter_table: table of parameter name, value, unit, target and source
evidence_map: per-fact source locator so a reviewer can re-open every number
coverage_report: status of the six required elements (procedure, setup, parameters, datasets, baselines, reproducibility and limitations)
open_questions: items only the author can confirm, each naming the file to open
